info.title: CallLoop OpenApi definition
info.description:
REST API for managing contacts and sending SMS, voice, and ringless messages from your own systems.

**Personal Access Token.** An organization owner creates a token in CallLoop (API settings, or GraphQL `createPersonalAccessToken`). The secret is shown once. Grant `contact:read` / `contact:write` and `message:read` / `message:write` as needed.

**Header.** Send every request with `Authorization: Bearer pat_v1.<token>`. The `pat_v1.` prefix is required.

**Phone numbers.** Prefer E.164 (`+15551234567`). National US numbers without a country code are accepted. `fromNumber` on send must belong to your account. Invalid `fromNumber` or `toNumber` returns HTTP 400 naming the field.

**Send, then poll.** `POST /api/public/v1/message/sms|voice|ringless` accepts the message and returns HTTP 200 with `state.status` = `Queued`. That means it is accepted for sending, not that the carrier delivered it. Poll `GET /api/public/v1/message/{id}` with the returned numeric `id` or `state.uuid` until a terminal status (`Delivered`, `Sent`, `Failed`, `Skipped`, and similar).

**Rate limits.** The gateway may return HTTP 429 when the organization exceeds its request quota. SMS from a given number may also be throttled (about 2 messages per second when throttling is enabled). Retry with backoff.

**Media IDs.** `assetIds`, `cardIds`, `audioIds`, and `audioId` must already exist in the account. Upload audio and assets in CallLoop first; send endpoints do not accept file uploads.

**Sorting.** List endpoints accept `sort` as `property,asc` or `property,desc`. Example: `sort=createdAt,desc`. Repeat `sort` to order by more than one field. An unknown property or direction returns HTTP 400 naming the invalid value.

get.description:
Use this to load one contact by numeric ID after create, or when you already store the ID.

Required: path `contactId`. Optional: none.

200.description: Contact as stored (`status`, opt-in, lists, custom fields). Not a message delivery confirmation.

404.description: No contact with that id exists in your organization.

put.description:
Use this to replace fields on an existing contact (full update).

Required: path `contactId` and a body. `phoneNumber` is required to change or keep the number. Other fields are optional; omitted values may be cleared depending on the field.

200.description: Contact after save. Not a send or delivery result.

patch.description:
Use this to change only the fields you send (partial update). Unspecified fields are left as they are.

Required: path `contactId`. Optional body: any subset of contact fields, including an empty body.

200.description: Contact after the patch. Not a send or delivery result.

put.description:
Use this to set SMS and call/ringless subscription states for one contact.

Required: `contactId` plus `textMessageState` and/or `callAndRinglessState` (`SUBSCRIBED` or `SOFT_UNSUBSCRIBED`). Optional: omit a channel to leave it unchanged if the body allows.

200.description: Saved opt-in payload. No message is sent.
OK

post.description:
Use this to queue one outbound voice call (uploaded audio for live answer and/or voicemail).

Required: `fromNumber`, `toNumber`, and `voiceMessage` with at least one enabled audio (`liveAnswer.audioId` and/or `voiceMail.audioId`). Optional: `validOnly` (skip DNC contacts), `premiumAmDetectionEnabled`, transfer settings. Audio IDs must already exist in the account.

200.description: Call queued (`state.status` = `Queued`), not answered or delivered. DNC + `validOnly` may already be `Skipped`.

400.description: Invalid payload, missing audio, or `fromNumber` / `toNumber` failed format validation.

404.description: Call transfer is enabled but `liveAnswer.transferCallNumber` was not provided.

post.description:
Use this to queue one SMS. The destination contact is matched or created from `toNumber`.

Required: `fromNumber` (a number on your account), `toNumber`, and `smsMessage` (`text` is the body). Optional: `validOnly`, `compliance` / `complianceText`, `shortenUrls`, `assetIds`, `cardIds`, `audioIds`. `shortenUrls` replaces URLs in `text` with tracked short links before the message is queued. Those media IDs must already exist in CallLoop; this endpoint does not upload files. `validOnly` is accepted on SMS but DNC skip at queue time applies to voice and ringless.

200.description: Message queued (`state.status` = `Queued`), not delivered. Poll GET /api/public/v1/message/{id}.

400.description: Invalid payload, empty SMS `text`, or `fromNumber` / `toNumber` failed format validation.

post.description:
Use this to queue a ringless voicemail drop.

Required: `fromNumber`, `toNumber`, and `ringlessMessage.audioId` (an audio item already uploaded in CallLoop). Optional: `validOnly` (skip DNC contacts), `callbackEnabled`.

200.description: Drop queued (`state.status` = `Queued`), not deposited. DNC + `validOnly` may already be `Skipped`.

400.description: Invalid payload, missing `audioId`, or `fromNumber` / `toNumber` failed format validation.

get.description:
Use this to page through contacts in the authenticated organization, optionally filtered.

Required: a PAT with `contact:read`. Optional query filters: `status`, `searchPattern`, subscription states, excluded lists/contacts. Pagination: `page`, `size` (default 20, max 250), `sort` (example: `createdAt,desc`). An unknown sort property returns HTTP 400.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Contact lifecycle filter (`Active`, `Archived`, …). Not a message delivery status.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Number of contacts per page. Default: 20. Max: 250.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort as property,asc or property,desc. Example: createdAt,desc. An unknown property or direction returns HTTP 400.

200.description: Page of contacts as stored. `status` is the contact lifecycle (`Active`, `Archived`, …), not a message delivery result. Deleted contacts are not listed.

post.description:
Use this to add a contact before sending, or to store CRM fields you will personalize later.

Required: `phoneNumber`. Optional: name, email, `timeZoneType`, `customFields`, `listIds`. Duplicate phone numbers for the same organization are rejected (unless the existing row was deleted).

200.description: Contact saved. Does not mean a message was sent or delivered.

delete.description:
Use this to permanently delete a known set of contacts by ID.

Required: query `contactIds`. Optional: none.

200.description: Confirmation string with the number deleted. Deletes are finished in this response.

post.description:
Use this to stop messaging one contact without deleting them (soft unsubscribe / opt-out).

Required: path `contactId`. Optional: none.

200.description: Contact with updated subscription state. No message is sent.

post.description:
Use this after explicit consent to allow messaging a previously unsubscribed contact.

Required: path `contactId`. Optional: none.

200.description: Contact with updated subscription state. No message is sent.

post.description:
Use this to see which contacts would match campaign trigger configs before launching a campaign.

Required: a body of trigger configs. Optional: pagination (`page`, `size`, `sort`).

post.description:
Use this to queue or run Do-Not-Call verification for contacts.

Required: a body with `ids` or a filter. If `ids` is present, those contacts are marked for verification immediately.                     If `ids` is omitted, a background job runs.

byFilter.description: Each inner array is an OR group. Do not send `filters` in the same request.

200.description: Verification requested or queued, not that DNC lookup has finished for every contact.

post.description:
Use this to restore archived contacts to Active.

Required: a body with `ids` or a filter. If `ids` is present, those contacts are unarchived immediately. If `ids` is omitted, a background job runs.

byFilter.description: Each inner array is an OR group. Do not send `filters` in the same request.

200.description: Confirmation string. With `ids`, the change is already applied. Without `ids`, the job is queued, not finished.

post.description:
Use this to soft-unsubscribe many contacts at once.

Required: a body with `ids` or a filter (`searchPattern` / `filter`). If `ids` is present, those contacts are updated immediately. If `ids` is omitted, a background job runs.

byFilter.description: Each inner array is an OR group. Do not send `filters` in the same request.

200.description: Confirmation string. With `ids`, the change is already applied. Without `ids`, the job is queued, not finished.

post.description:
Use this to detach contacts from one or more lists.

Required: query `listIds`, plus a body with `ids` or a filter. If `ids` is present, membership is updated immediately. If `ids` is omitted, a background job runs.

byFilter.description: Each inner array is an OR group. Do not send `filters` in the same request.

200.description: Confirmation string. Immediate removals are finished; a started job is queued, not complete.

post.description:
Use this to re-subscribe many contacts at once after consent.

Required: a body with `ids` or a filter. If `ids` is present, those contacts are updated immediately. If `ids` is omitted, a background job runs.

byFilter.description: Each inner array is an OR group. Do not send `filters` in the same request.

200.description: Confirmation string. With `ids`, the change is already applied. Without `ids`, the job is queued, not finished.

post.description:
Use this to permanently delete many contacts by IDs or by filter.

Required: a body with `ids` or a filter. If `ids` is present, those contacts are deleted immediately. If `ids` is omitted, a background job runs.

byFilter.description: Each inner array is an OR group. Do not send `filters` in the same request.

200.description: Confirmation string (count deleted, or that a bulk job started). Immediate deletes are finished; a started job is queued.

post.description:
Use this to archive many contacts (they leave Active lists but are not deleted).

Required: a body with `ids` or a filter. If `ids` is present, those contacts are archived immediately. If `ids` is omitted, a background job runs.

byFilter.description: Each inner array is an OR group. Do not send `filters` in the same request.

200.description: Confirmation string. With `ids`, archive is already applied. Without `ids`, the job is queued, not finished.

post.description:
Use this to attach contacts to one or more lists.

Required: query `listIds`, plus a body with `ids` or a filter. If `ids` is present, membership is updated immediately. If `ids` is omitted, a background job runs.

byFilter.description: Each inner array is an OR group. Do not send `filters` in the same request.

200.description: Confirmation string (count added, or that a bulk job started). Immediate adds are finished; a started job is queued.

get.summary: Get a message by numeric id or state UUID
get.description:
Use this to poll after send until a terminal status. Pass the numeric `id` or `state.uuid` from the send response.

Required: path `id`. Optional: none. Check `state.status` (full lifecycle), `state.simpleStatus` (collapsed), and `extStatus` (provider-facing). Keep polling while status is `Queued` / `Pending`.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Message numeric ID or state UUID

200.description: Current snapshot, not a delivery guarantee. `Queued`/`Pending` means still in flight.

404.description: No message with that numeric id or state UUID exists in your organization.

phoneNumber.description: Contact phone number. Required on create and full update; optional on patch. Prefer E.164 (`+15551234567`); national US format is accepted.

status.description: Contact lifecycle (`Active`, `Archived`, `Unsubscribed`, …). Not a message delivery status.

fromNumber.description: Caller ID / from number on your CallLoop account. Prefer E.164 (`+15551234567`). Invalid format returns HTTP 400 (`From number is invalid`).

toNumber.description: Destination number. Prefer E.164 (`+15551234567`). Matched or created as a contact. Invalid format returns HTTP 400 (`To number is invalid`).

voiceMessage.description: Voice payload. At least one enabled audio ID is required (`liveAnswer` and/or `voiceMail`).

audioId.description: ID of an existing audio item played on live answer. Upload audio in CallLoop first; send does not accept files.

validOnly.description: When true, skip sending if the destination contact is on the DNC list (`state.status` = `Skipped`). Default false.

premiumAmDetectionEnabled.description: When true, use premium answering-machine detection (more accurate AMD; may incur extra cost). Default false.

audioId.description: ID of an existing audio item left as voicemail. Upload audio in CallLoop first; send does not accept files.

extStatus.description: Carrier/provider-facing status, distinct from `state.status` and `state.simpleStatus`. For SMS and ringless this is typically `simpleStatus`. For voice this is the provider call result (for example CallFire).

penaltyApplied.description: True when a short-call penalty was billed (voice duration of about 6 seconds or less). False if no penalty applied.

extStatusDescription.description: Human-readable explanation of `extStatus` when the provider supplies one.

status.description: Full internal lifecycle: `Queued` (accepted, not yet sent), `Sent`, `Delivered`, `Failed`, `Skipped`, and similar. A send HTTP 200 with `Queued` means queued, not delivered. Distinct from `simpleStatus` (collapsed bucket) and top-level `extStatus` (provider-facing).

simpleStatus.description: Collapsed status for clients: `Pending` (in flight, including `Queued`), `Success` (`Sent`/`Delivered`), `Failed` (`Failed`/`Declined`/`Invalid`/`Undelivered`), plus a few passthrough values (`Skipped`, `Unsubscribed`, …). Distinct from `status` (full lifecycle) and `extStatus` (provider-facing).

fromNumber.description: Caller ID / from number on your CallLoop account. Prefer E.164 (`+15551234567`). Invalid format returns HTTP 400 (`From number is invalid`).

toNumber.description: Destination number. Prefer E.164 (`+15551234567`). Matched or created as a contact. Invalid format returns HTTP 400 (`To number is invalid`).

smsMessage.description: SMS payload. `text` is the body; media IDs must already exist in the account.

text.description: SMS body. Required on send; an empty value returns HTTP 400. Personalization tokens are resolved at send time.

compliance.description: When true, append the STOP/HELP compliance footer to the body. Use GET /api/public/v1/message/compliance for the default text.

shortenUrls.description: When true, resolve personalization tokens, then replace each URL in the body with a tracked short link on the account's primary short domain (or a default CallLoop domain). Default false. The link is stamped with this message's id at send time.

validOnly.description: When true, skip sending to contacts on the DNC list. Default false.

complianceText.description: Extra text appended after the standard `Reply STOP to end.` prefix when `compliance` is true. Ignored when `compliance` is false.

assetIds.description: IDs of existing MMS/assets in the account. Upload assets in CallLoop first; send does not accept files.

cardIds.description: IDs of existing contact cards in the account. Not created on send.

audioIds.description: IDs of existing audio items in the account. Upload audio in CallLoop first; send does not accept files.

fromNumber.description: Caller ID / from number on your CallLoop account. Prefer E.164 (`+15551234567`). Invalid format returns HTTP 400 (`From number is invalid`).

toNumber.description: Destination number. Prefer E.164 (`+15551234567`). Matched or created as a contact. Invalid format returns HTTP 400 (`To number is invalid`).

ringlessMessage.description: Ringless payload. `audioId` must already exist in the account.

audioId.description: ID of an existing audio item in the account. Upload audio in CallLoop first; send does not accept files.

validOnly.description: When true, skip sending if the destination contact is on the DNC list (`state.status` = `Skipped`). Default false.

field.description:
Built-in field key, or custom field key when type is CUSTOM.

Built-in fields:
- `FIRST_NAME` — First name (CONTACT, TEXT)
- `LAST_NAME` — Last name (CONTACT, TEXT)
- `EMAIL` — Email (CONTACT, TEXT)
- `PHONE_NUMBER` — Phone number (CONTACT, PHONE)
- `PHONE_TYPE` — Phone type (LOOKUP, TEXT)
- `CARRIER_NAME` — Carrier name (LOOKUP, TEXT)
- `CREATED_AT` — Created at (CONTACT, DATE)
- `UPDATED_AT` — Updated at (CONTACT, DATE)
- `STATUS` — Contact status (CONTACT, SELECT)
- `OPT_IN` — Opt-in method (CONTACT, SELECT)
- `DNC` — Do not call (LOOKUP, BOOLEAN)
- `TIME_ZONE` — Time zone (CONTACT, SELECT)
- `LAST_SHORT_CLICK` — Last link clicked (ACTIVITY, DATE_TIME)
- `LAST_CALLBACK` — Last callback (ACTIVITY, DATE_TIME)
- `LAST_CALL_FORWARD` — Last call forwarded (ACTIVITY, DATE_TIME)
- `LAST_CALL_TRANSFER` — Last call transferred (ACTIVITY, DATE_TIME)
- `LAST_CONTACTED` — Last contacted (ACTIVITY, DATE_TIME)
- `LAST_SMS` — Last SMS (ACTIVITY, DATE_TIME)
- `LAST_VOICE` — Last Voice (ACTIVITY, DATE_TIME)
- `LAST_RINGLESS` — Last Ringless (ACTIVITY, DATE_TIME)
- `LAST_INBOUND` — Last Inbound (ACTIVITY, DATE_TIME)
- `LAST_MESSAGE_STATUS` — Last message status (ACTIVITY, SELECT)
- `TOTAL_SMS` — Total SMS (ACTIVITY, NUMBER)
- `TOTAL_VOICE` — Total Voice (ACTIVITY, NUMBER)
- `TOTAL_RINGLESS` — Total Ringless (ACTIVITY, NUMBER)
- `LIST` — List (CONTACT, LIST)
- `SEGMENT` — Segment (SEGMENTS, SEGMENT)

Custom fields: use the key from your account with `type=CUSTOM`. Example: `company_name` (CUSTOM, TEXT).

value.description: Primary comparison value. Multi-value conditions (IN, CONTAINS_ANY, …) are comma-separated.

valueExt.description: Second bound for BETWEEN / NOT_BETWEEN date filters. Omit otherwise.

dataType.description: Must match the field data type. For custom fields use the custom field type.

type.description: CONTACT, ACTIVITY, LOOKUP, or SEGMENTS for built-in fields. CUSTOM for a custom field key.

condition.description: Operator for this field. Allowed operators depend on dataType.

orIndex.description: OR group. Same orIndex values are ANDed; different orIndex values are ORed.

andIndex.description: Position inside the OR group. Must be unique together with orIndex.

FilterValue.description: Audience selector. Combine list/contact/segment IDs with either filters or sourceFilters, not both.

sourceFilters.description: Grouped filters. Each inner list is a group; groups are ORed. Inside a group, same orIndex values are ANDed. Do not send together with filters.

filters.description: Flat filter list. AND/OR is expressed with orIndex/andIndex. Do not send together with sourceFilters.

bearerAuth.description: Personal Access Token. Send as: Authorization: Bearer pat_v1.<token>

tags.name: Contacts
tags.description: Create, look up, and update contacts. Requires a PAT with contact:read or contact:write.

tags.name: Messages
tags.description: Send SMS, voice, and ringless voicemail, then poll for delivery. Requires a PAT with message:read or message:write.
